deviations.what: Breadth-probe: the ACE-based sap.ui.codeeditor CodeEditor (a wrapped third-party editor). **Both findings of the 2026-07-27 review are fixed (2026-08-05)**: the value carries all TWELVE language entries of the original verbatim (it had been shortened to four, against the verbatim-data rule), and the brace escaping is right. The original's own view.xml writes value='\{…' - the backslash has to SURVIVE into the serialized attribute or the XMLView parser reads the JSON braces as a binding - so the braces come from `backtick` literals (taken verbatim) while the body uses |…| templates for the real newlines; inside a template \{ would collapse to a bare brace. That distinction is now a linter rule of its own (escaped-brace-in-backtick, the mirror of collapsed-brace-in-style).
